names: keyboard: Down, Up, Home and End move through the permissions that show
keyboard: Right opens a branch and then enters it, Left goes to the parent and then closes it
keyboard: the tree is 1 tab stop, and each permission has its level and place
keyboard: Space on a branch checks all of it, Space again clears it, and Enter checks 1 permission
keyboard: unchecking 1 permission makes each branch above it mixed
keyboard: a locked permission keeps its state, and its branch stays mixed
pointer: a click on the arrow opens a branch, and a click on the row checks it
keyboard: typing a letter moves to the next permission that starts with it
pattern: the tree passes the tree pattern check
server: the permission tree renders with no DOM
direction: Right and Left follow the text direction
names: the page names the tree, each permission and the button, and shows the 3 states
keyboard: on the page, Space checks a section and 1 permission, and the status line reports it
agent: an agent finds the tree, checks a section, unchecks 1 permission and saves, and cannot change a locked one
